task_completion.description: Open the Subsurface logbook application and load the dive data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Subsurface application window is visible, showing a list of dives.

task_completion.description: Identify or filter dives with a maximum depth of 18.0m or greater.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent is seen selecting multiple dives, using a filter tool, or sorting the 'Max Depth' column to isolate dives >= 18.0m.

task_completion.description: Apply the tag 'Deep' to the identified dives.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Tags' field in the dive information pane shows 'Deep' being typed or applied to the selected dives.

task_completion.description: Save the updated dive log to the specific path /home/ga/Documents/dives.ssrf.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog box is visible with the path '/home/ga/Documents/dives.ssrf' entered in the filename field.

task_completion.description: Confirm the file has been saved successfully.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The save dialog closes, and the application title bar or a file manager window confirms the existence of 'dives.ssrf' in the Documents folder.

integrity.description: The agent used the Subsurface GUI to modify tags rather than editing the XML file directly via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show interactions with the Subsurface interface (clicking, typing in fields) rather than just 'sed' or 'echo' commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create a dummy file with the expected name without using the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the Subsurface application open and active during the tagging process.

integrity.description: The agent applied the tag only to dives meeting the criteria, not a blanket application to all dives.
integrity.visual_evidence: Selection highlights or individual dive records show that shallower dives (e.g., Dive 2, 3, 4) do not have the 'Deep' tag.
